name: Filen
author: CatalinGB
description: Filen end-to-end-encrypted cloud storage in the Omarchy bar: mount status, storage usage, and recent files, backed by a systemd-supervised FUSE mount.

barWidget.description: See the Filen mount status, storage usage, and recent files, and mount or unmount on demand.

schema.label: Mount folder
schema.description: Where the Filen drive appears. Changing this after setup requires the mount to be restarted.

schema.label: Cache size limit (GB)
schema.description: Upper bound on the RAM-backed VFS cache. Least recently used files are evicted first.

schema.label: Status refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often mount status is checked. This reads local system state only, so it is cheap.

schema.label: Storage/recents refresh (minutes)
schema.description: How often storage usage and recent files are fetched. This talks to Filen over the network, so keep it slow.

schema.label: Show text in bar
schema.description: Print the mount state next to the bar icon.

schema.label: Show recent files
schema.description: List recently changed files in the panel. Turn off if you mainly use Filen for backup.
